name: SaifBrand SEO, Speed & Security
author: SaifBrand

sections.description:
SaifBrand SEO, Speed & Security handles the technical work every WordPress site needs — being found, loading fast, and not being broken into — without needing five different plugins.

Image Optimization

  • Automatically converts new JPEG/PNG uploads to WebP, including every generated thumbnail size
  • One-click bulk optimization for your existing Media Library
  • Automatically fills in missing image alt text so you stop losing accessibility and SEO points on empty alt attributes
  • Optional max-width resize and a minimum-file-size threshold, so tiny icons aren’t needlessly reprocessed
  • Before/after savings report so you can see exactly how much smaller your images got

SEO

  • Custom SEO title and meta description on every post and page, with a simple field right on the edit screen
  • Site-wide title separator, optional site-name suffix, and a fallback default meta description
  • Automatic XML sitemap (can be turned off), no configuration needed
  • Optional noindex on WordPress’s auto-generated attachment pages
  • Clean, correct robots.txt with your sitemap linked automatically
  • Proper canonical tags and Open Graph tags on every page
  • Automatically steps aside if you already have Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO active, so nothing ever gets duplicated

Speed

  • Forces lazy-loading on every content image, even ones that slip through WordPress’s own default handling, with an option to skip the first N images so your hero image still loads immediately
  • Optional one-click disabling of the emoji-detection script and the oEmbed script
  • (Pro) Full-page caching for logged-out visitors, with smart exclusions for cart, checkout, and account pages

Why SaifBrand SEO & Speed

Most sites end up running a separate image-compression plugin, a separate SEO plugin, and a separate caching plugin — each with its own settings screen, its own updates, and its own way of doing things. SaifBrand SEO & Speed keeps the essentials in one place, with sensible defaults that work out of the box.

Pro (separate add-on)

Everything listed above is fully included and unrestricted in this free plugin. SaifBrand SEO & Speed Pro is a separate add-on plugin, distributed outside of WordPress.org, that layers on full-page speed caching, AI-generated alt text, AI-generated meta descriptions, AVIF image support, and priority support. Learn more.

Spam & Bot Protection

  • An invisible honeypot and a timing check on comments, registration and contact forms. No keys, no account, and nothing for your visitors to solve
  • Optional Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA using your own free keys — nothing is billed to us or routed through us
  • Works with Contact Form 7, WPForms and Elementor Pro forms
  • If the captcha service is ever unreachable, submissions are let through rather than silently blocked. An outage should not take your contact form down with it

Login Protection

  • Lock out repeated failed sign-ins from the same address
  • Stop WordPress confirming which usernames exist, on the login form and through the REST API
  • Turn off XML-RPC, whose pingback feature is regularly abused to attack other sites
  • Disable the built-in theme and plugin file editor

File Integrity Scan

  • Compares every WordPress core file against the official checksums published by wordpress.org, so an altered or injected core file shows up immediately
  • Looks through wp-content for the small set of patterns common to web shells, and for PHP where it does not belong
  • This is not a full malware scanner — those need a signature list updated daily. It catches altered core files and the common shell patterns, which is how most break-ins show themselves

Contact Form Messages

  • Contact Form 7 keeps no copy of anything: it sends an email and forgets. A missed email is a lost enquiry
  • Switch this on and every submission is also saved on your own site, readable from the WPVane app

Traffic

  • A simple visitor count: views, visits, most-read pages, and where people came from
  • No third-party service, no cookies, and nothing personal is stored — only totals per day
  • Counting happens in the browser after the page has loaded, so it stays off the request your visitor is waiting on and still works with full-page caching

App Control (optional, off by default)

  • Connect the site to the WPVane app in one click, without hunting for the Application Passwords section
  • If WordPress has application passwords switched off, the screen names the exact reason and the fix
  • Adds updates, theme switching and site health to what the app can do
  • Nothing is registered or listening until you turn it on, and disconnecting revokes the credential
sections.installation:
1. Upload the saifbrand-seo-speed folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “SaifBrand SEO & Speed” menu item in your dashboard sidebar to review settings — the defaults are safe to leave as-is.
  4. Optionally click “Bulk Optimize” to convert your existing Media Library images to WebP and fill in any missing alt text.
sections.faq:
Will this break my images if something goes wrong?

SaifBrand SEO & Speed only replaces a JPEG/PNG with its WebP equivalent after the WebP file has been successfully created and verified on disk. Always keep a backup of your site as a general practice, as you should with any plugin that modifies media files.

Does this work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. SaifBrand SEO & Speed automatically detects if Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO is active and steps aside from all SEO output (titles, meta tags, sitemap) so there’s no conflict or duplication. The image optimization and speed features keep working regardless.

Do I need to keep the original JPEG/PNG files?

No. Once an image is converted to WebP, the original is removed and the WebP file takes its place at the same location in your Media Library, so no other plugin or theme code needs to change.

What does the free version include versus Pro?

Everything listed under Image Optimization, SEO, and the lazy-loading part of Speed is free, permanently. Pro adds full-page caching and AI-powered content generation for alt text and meta descriptions.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Fixed: with “Also protect the login form” switched on, the timing check could turn away a real person whose password manager filled the form instantly. Sign-in no longer has a minimum fill time; the honeypot and the lockout still apply there. Comments and contact forms are unchanged.
  • The plugin is now called SaifBrand SEO, Speed & Security everywhere, matching what it does.
  • New screenshots for the Security and App Control screens.

1.2.0

  • New Security tab: spam and bot protection for comments, login, registration, Contact Form 7, WPForms and Elementor forms. Works with no keys at all, and optionally with Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA using your own free keys.
  • New: login protection – lock out repeated failed sign-ins, hide which usernames exist, turn off XML-RPC, disable the built-in file editor.
  • New: file integrity scan. Compares every WordPress core file against the official checksums from wordpress.org, and looks through wp-content for code that does not belong there.
  • New: keep a copy of contact form submissions, so a lost email is not a lost enquiry.
  • New: simple visitor counting. No third-party service, no cookies, nothing personal stored – only daily totals, top pages and referrers.
  • New App Control tab: connect the site to the WPVane app in one click, with a clear explanation when WordPress has application passwords switched off. Off until you turn it on.
  • Fixed: the settings tab name from the URL is now sanitised before use.

1.1.2

  • Fixed: other active plugins’ admin notices (e.g. Elementor’s) no longer appear on this plugin’s own settings page.
  • Added an optional, dismissible review request after a week of active use.

1.1.1

  • Sidebar: replaced the WhatsApp contact link with a direct Live Chat link, and added a link to the plugin’s full details/live demo page.

1.1.0

  • Renamed to SaifBrand SEO & Speed per WordPress.org naming guidance (the plugin itself is unchanged).

1.0.0

  • Initial release: WebP image optimization, alt text auto-fill, on-page SEO, XML sitemap, lazy-load enforcement, and Pro-tier full-page caching.
